theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (lam Lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (A : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (V : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (y : Rn n) (ρ : ℝ) (c : Rn ℓ), (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ A P P) → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |A P Q| ≤ Lam * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → 0 < ρ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 V (ball y (2 * ρ)) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball y (2 * ρ) → ∫ x, A (fderiv ℝ V x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ∫⁻ x in ball y ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ V x‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C / ρ ^ 2) * ∫⁻ x in ball y (2 * ρ), ‖V x - c‖ₑ ^ 2
